settings.heading: Product features
settings.content:
The POV - Key Chain 2.0 is designed to accommodate for all mobile phone types and models. 

One for the bigger types of mobile phones & another one for smaller types.

It includes a unique double-sided design for aesthetic purposes. 

The POV - Glassy 2.0 is double sided, portable, reusable, strong, adhesive-free, easy to use & removable.

settings.heading: Materials and care
settings.content:
The POV - Key Chain 2.0 is made of super powerful rubber-like material. 

The POV - Glassy 2.0 is made of a special type of silicon.

settings.heading: Merchandising tips
settings.content:
For the POV - Key Chain 2.0, in order to optimize your phone's stance, adjust your phone's stance for deciding on the best angle. Also, make sure to use the Key Chain on flat surfaces (Nor inclining, neither declining one). 

For the POV - Glassy 2.0, in order to optimize performance and avoid phone damage, make sure its always clean, dust-free, pressed on prior to usage & used for 15 minutes maximum before re-applying.
